hypothesis: A genuinely different neural inductive bias — FT-Transformer (attention over feature tokens) and DCNv2 (explicit feature crosses) — can add incremental value as an 11th member of the v7 portfolio, decorrelated from the tree-heavy champion and its existing RealMLP/TabM (feedforward) members.
why_distinct_from_prior_negatives: The champion already contains RealMLP/TabM (feedforward MLPs) but no attention-over-features (FT-Transformer) or explicit-cross (DCNv2) network. The FLM class (7/7: TabICL/TabDPT/Causilo/TabFM/xRFM/Mitra/Kumo) is closed negative; neural P2 is the primary remaining untested inductive-bias class (queue rank 6).
env: certified .venv (torch 2.11.0+cu128, CUDA); MY code — not a downloaded foundation model, so no .venv_ag isolation needed; numpy/torch stack not upgraded

protocol.view: champion raw21+coarse10 route representation via frames(tr,te,route=True) = 22 features
protocol.fold: primary_5f_seed20261010; fold-0 discovery screen (F2; cannot pass admission gate)
protocol.inner_es: carve 10% of FIT (stratified, seed 1) as val for early-stopping checkpoint selection; NEVER the eval fold; scaler (standardize) fit on FIT-train only
protocol.predict: fold-0 EVAL rows; screen_metrics vs hash-asserted champion portfolio/route
protocol.standardize: zero-mean unit-var scaler fit on FIT-train only (fold-safe)

fttransformer.recipe: canonical FT-Transformer (Gorishniy et al. 2021): feature tokenizer t_j = x_j*w_j + b_j -> d_token; CLS token; Pre-LN transformer encoder; CLS -> MLP head

dcnv2.recipe: canonical DCNv2 (Wang et al. 2021): cross layers x_{l+1}=x_0*(W_l x_l + b_l)+x_l (explicit crosses) concatenated with deep MLP; joint output

optimization: AdamW; BCEWithLogitsLoss; linear warmup 5%% then cosine decay; early-stop on inner-val AUC (patience es_patience); best-checkpoint predict
promising_bar: PROMISING iff portfolio_delta >= +5e-5 AND logit_pearson_vs_portfolio < 0.995 for an architecture -> then promote that architecture to full 5-fold OOF + admission-gate run
negative_rule: if every architecture has portfolio_delta < +5e-5 (or negative), record NEGATIVE for the exact frozen recipes + protocol and do not rerun identically; any future retry must change a predeclared mechanism (different architecture, representation, or training regime), not re-tune the same recipe

compute.budget_gpu_hours: within phase-20 remaining (~8h after Mitra/Kumo); FT-Transformer + DCNv2 fold-0 each ~15-30 min on GPU

anti_leakage: train on FIT only (folds 1-4); eval fold (fold 0) never seen in training
inner ES split carved from FIT only (never eval fold)
no target encoding (route view is label-free)
champion reference hash-asserted from phase17 artifacts
